changes: Scope of the 40% clamp. The 40% limit of Law 1393 of 2010 art. 30 applies only to payments that would remunerate the service but were agreed as non-salary under Labour Code art. 128 (second limb) or a collective agreement — the WTC wage types marked 'Non-Salary - pacted'. Payments that are non-salary by law or by nature, because they do not remunerate the service — the transport and connectivity allowances, occasional per diem, means and tools to do the job, dotación, payments by mere liberality, indemnities — are excluded from both sides of the test: they do not enter the contribution base and they are not counted in the total remuneration against which the 40% is measured (WTC 'Non-Salary - non-remunerative'). Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, unification ruling rad. 05001-23-33-000-2016-02496-01 (25185), 9 December 2021: "el límite del 40% será aplicable a los pagos que, siendo salariales, las partes deciden excluirlos de la base gravable, y no a los emolumentos que por disposición legal no son salariales." Where the nature of a payment is unclear, it is treated as pacted and the Non-Salary Pact Flag in the DD decides.
